what: An app that takes attendance in class: students check in with their phone, the teacher sees who is there.
users: Teachers and students of one department (about 40 teachers, 1,200 students). Teachers on laptops, students on phones.
mustHaves: Teacher opens a session for a class
Students check in during the first 10 minutes
Teacher sees the list live and can fix it by hand
deadline: 6 weeks, demo to the teacher in week 6
outsideRules: Student data must stay in the EU
The teacher wants it to work on the school Wi-Fi
feel: Simple, like the school's own pages.
